content.short: Tape is a decentralized video-sharing social media platform powered by Lens Protocol.
content.description: Tape (formerly Lenstube) decentralizes social video sharing and delivers a YouTube-like experience built around user-owned content. The interface includes an Explore page that surfaces videos similar to what you've recently watched and a Bytes short-form feed that echoes popular TikTok or YouTube Shorts formats. Viewers can tip creators with MATIC and the platform offers the ability to curate videos as NFTs, enabling collectible and tradable content within the ecosystem.
